title: Binance Margin Adds New USDC Pairs - 2024-04-18
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Margin has added new USDC trading pairs on Cross and Isolated Margin.  Cross Margin Isolated Margin New Trading Pairs ALT/USDC ,  BCH/USDC ,  FIL/USDC ,  PENDLE/USDC ALT/USDC ,  BCH/USDC ,  FIL/USDC ,  LTC/USDC ,  NEAR/USDC ,  PENDLE/USDC Explore Binance Margin Now!
